title: Traditional English Trifle
description: A classic English dessert made with layers of sponge cake, fruit, custard, and whipped cream.
instructions: Cut the sponge cake into 1-inch cubes.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed berries and granulated sugar.
In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Split the vanilla pod lengthwise and scrape the seeds into the custard.
In a separate saucepan, heat the custard over low heat until warmed through.
To assemble the trifle, begin with a layer of sponge cake cubes in the bottom of a large serving dish.
Next, add a layer of mixed berries, followed by a layer of custard.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of whipped cream on top.
If using, sprinkle a layer of candied fruit on top of the whipped cream.
If using, drizzle a layer of sherry over the top of the trifle.
Refrigerate the trifle for at least 30 minutes before serving.
